title: 第2章 你们觉得他的命不值八万块-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “是你二哥。”

    “你二哥那天回来，手上全是血，分不清是姓王的血还是他自己的。

    他坐在院子里抽了半包烟，跟我说了一句话……‘我妹妹嫁过去不是让人打的。’”

    林美丽“哇”的一声哭了出来。

    “美丽，你二哥这辈子没求过谁。

    他现在躺在里面，就差那八万块钱。

    你穿金戴银，你住大房子，你开小汽车，你就不能……”

    “二嫂，我……”

    林美丽哭得说不出话，旁边的陈江赶紧接话：“二嫂，不是美丽不想帮，我们家里最近也紧张，厂子里压了一批货……”

    “行了。”赵素梅打断了他，声音突然平静得可怕，“陈江，你不用说了。

    你刚才在楼梯间跟你媳妇说的话，我不小心听见了。

    你说‘你二哥那病是个无底洞，借出去的钱就是打水漂，有去无回’。”

    陈江的脸“唰”地白了。

    走廊里死一般的寂静。

    然后赵素梅转向了林海柱和李红霞，声音已经沙哑得几乎听不清了：

    “爹，妈，老二是不是你们亲生的？”

    “你这说的什么混账话！”李红霞急了，“国强当然是我亲生的！我十月怀胎生下来的！”

    “那你们为什么见死不救？！”

    赵素梅终于崩溃了，声音撕心裂肺，每一个字都带着二十年的委屈和不甘：

    “他这辈子对谁不好了吗？！他亏待过谁吗？！

    你们哪家有事不是他第一个到？哪家要帮忙不是他搭把手？

    大哥家盖房子，他搬了三天砖，肩膀磨掉一层皮，连顿饭都没吃就走了，说是怕给你们添麻烦！”

    “老三厂子开业，他把自己辛辛苦苦攒的三千块钱借给你周转，到现在十五年了，你还了吗？！”

    “美丽被欺负，他豁出命去替你出头！”

    “爹，您去年住院，是谁在病床前守了二十天？

    是老二！端屎端尿，擦身喂饭，您半夜要喝水，他眯瞪着眼睛爬起来，倒水试温度，扶着您喝。

    您出院那天，他瘦了十五斤！”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

"It's your second brother."

“Your second brother came back that day, his hands were full of blood, and he couldn’t tell whether it was Wang’s blood or his own.

He sat in the yard and smoked half a pack of cigarettes, and said something to me...'My sister was not married to be beaten.’”

Lin Meili cried "Wow".

"Beautiful, your second brother has never begged anyone in his life.

He is lying inside now, and all he needs is the 80,000 yuan.

“You wear gold and silver, you live in a big house, you drive a car, but you can’t..."

"Second sister-in-law, I..."

Lin Meili cried so much that she couldn't speak. Chen Jiang who was next to her quickly answered: "Second sister-in-law, it's not that Meili doesn't want to help. Our family has also been nervous recently, and the factory has packed a batch of goods..."

"Okay." Zhao Sumei interrupted him, her voice suddenly terrifyingly calm, "Chen Jiang, you don't need to say anything.

“I accidentally overheard what you just said to your wife in the stairwell.

You said, ‘Your second brother’s illness is a bottomless pit, and the money he borrowed is wasted, and there is no return.’"

Chen Jiang's face turned pale.

The corridor was deathly silent.

Then Zhao Sumei turned to Lin Haizhu and Li Hongxia, her voice was so hoarse that it was almost inaudible:

"Dad, Mom, is the second child your biological child?"

"What the hell are you talking about!" Li Hongxia became anxious, "Of course Guoqiang is my biological child! I was born in ten months of pregnancy!"

“Then why don’t you save anyone?!”

Zhao Sumei finally broke down, her voice heartbreaking, every word carrying twenty years of grievance and unwillingness:

“Has he treated anyone badly in his life?! Has he ever wronged anyone?!

​​Which of your houses is he not the first to arrive when something happens?Who wants to help but he can help?

When my eldest brother’s family was building a house, he had to move bricks for three days, and a layer of skin was worn off his shoulders. He left without even eating, saying he was afraid of causing trouble to you!"

"When the third factory opened, he lent you the 3,000 yuan he had worked so hard to save for turnover. It has been fifteen years now, have you paid it back?!"

"Beauty was bullied, and he risked his life to stand up for you!"

"Dad, when you were hospitalized last year, who stayed at your bedside for twenty days?

It’s the second child!He feces and urinates, wipes himself and feeds you. When you ask for water in the middle of the night, he gets up with his eyes narrowed, pours water to test the temperature, and helps you drink.

The day you were discharged from the hospital, he lost fifteen pounds!"
